title: Among schools administered by one of the two most common administrator firs
question: Among schools administered by one of the two most common administrator first names, find those with an SAT excellence rate above 0.25. Return the school name, city, and the eligible free meal rate for students aged 5–17, sorted in descending order of that rate.

prediction.sql:
WITH top_admins AS (
  SELECT "XCL_080" AS admin_name
  FROM schools
  WHERE "XCL_080" IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY "XCL_080"
  ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
  LIMIT 2
)
SELECT s."XCL_047" AS school_name,
       s."XCL_050" AS city,
       CAST(f."XCL_025" AS REAL) / f."XCL_024" AS free_meal_rate
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores sat ON s."XCL_041" = sat."XCL_030"
JOIN frpm f ON s."XCL_041" = f."XCL_001"
WHERE s."XCL_080" IN (SELECT admin_name FROM top_admins)
  AND CAST(sat."XCL_040" AS REAL) / sat."XCL_036" > 0.25
ORDER BY free_meal_rate DESC

  WHERE "XCL_080" IS NOT NULL

  LIMIT 2

JOIN frpm f ON s."XCL_041" = f."XCL_001"
WHERE s."XCL_080" IN (SELECT admin_name FROM top_admins)

ORDER BY free_meal_rate DESC
